text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp, a
period
of intense training where runners
can improve
their skills.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, it's so hot! The glare of the sun
is making
me all woozy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...But I've heard that training in the heat
of
summer goes a long way towards
getting stronger!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta work harder than ever if I'm
aiming for
the Kikuka Sho and the spring
Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, give me everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... in exchange for my hard work,
will you
let me have two ice creams a
day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begins our intense summer camp.
